My takeaways from the justice for #GeorgeFloyd / #BlackLivesMatter protest in Worcester this afternoon. 

• Peacful - no violence. 
• Vast majority of cars honked in support. Little confrontation.
• Large group, lots of passionate speakers.
• Everyone wore masks. https://t.co/QWtDHbzycZ

I think I’ve figured out an effective way to explain #BlackLivesMattter to the All Lives Matter crowd.

Of corse every life matters, human life is precious and fragile, BUT it’s #BlackLivesMatter because they are the ones currently under attack and in immediate danger.

I know I’m just a white dude, so Black folks, feel free to correct me if I’m outta line. 

It’s just so crazy to me that everyone, down to a person, isn’t all on board with #BlackLivesMatter. It’s like the easiest statement to get behind.

Check out our interview with @RepMcGovern this morning.

His take on the nationwide Justice for #GeorgeFloyd / #BlackLivesMatter / Police Brutality protests sweeping America and all the issues that are wrapped up in it.

Thursdays at 8:15am.
https://t.co/TKpNDmz3sZ @McGovernMA

Also, another nuance that people won’t talk about, just because A small number of people are rioting and looting doesn’t mean that the #BlackLivesMatter message is any less valid or important. Nothing folks can do would undermine that meaning.
